# BearSSL 0.6

This source subset provides the upstream AES-128 constant-time CTR/CBC-MAC
backend and CCM mode. The firmware adapters live in `shared/aes_ccm.c`.
The vendor source and headers are unmodified. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).

Upstream release [bearssl-0.6.tar.gz](https://www.bearssl.org/bearssl-0.6.tar.gz)
has SHA-256
`6705bba1714961b41a728dfc5debbe348d2966c117649392f8c8139efc83ff14`.
